name: eta-range
title: ETA Range
description: Stops false-precision delivery promises by quoting the range that covers 90% of deliveries with a most likely day only when one really stands out ("Thu 15 – Sat 17 Oct, most likely Fri 16"), counting the shipper's business days, holidays and cutoff in its own time zone, previewing the range you get after the cutoff, naming no-delivery days inside it, and explaining when the estimate widened.

meta.stops: Delivery promised on an impossible day
